newsitem.title: USA: OnGard to sell Mailback assets to Sage.
newsitem.headline: OnGard to sell Mailback assets to Sage.

text.p: OnGard Systems Inc said Tuesday that it has signed a letter of intent to sell certain assets related to its sharps-container Mailback business to privately-held Sage Products Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The assets to be divested include patents, trademarks, inventory and customer account data of the sharps-container Mailback business, said OnGard. It expects the transaction to close in early July.

The proposed sale, said the company, reflects its continuing focus on its core businesses of proprietary disposable packaging line, AutoPak and related products, and sterilization equipment products, which are sold to the hospital and healthcare markets.
